## What is Sanganeri print?

Sanganeri print is the traditional block printing style of Sanganer, Jaipur – fine floral buttis, delicate creepers and soft colours on a light background. It is one of the most loved prints for everyday cotton kurtis because it looks fresh, elegant and suits every age.

## Our Sanganeri wholesale range

- Daily-wear cotton kurtis
- Office-wear straight kurtis
- Kurta, pant and dupatta sets
- Summer dresses and co-ord sets

## Wholesale benefits

- Factory prices from Sanganer, no middleman
- Mixed sizes per design
- New designs added regularly
- Catalogue and price list on WhatsApp

## How it works

Tell us the styles and quantity you need. We send you the latest catalogue and a written quotation. Orders are confirmed with advance payment and dispatched with tracking. [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886).
